Sure thing! To tailor a 5‑day New York itinerary that feels just right for you, I’d love to know a bit more about your preferences:

| What I’d like to know | Why it matters |
|-----------------------|----------------|
| **Interests** (e.g., museums, theater, food, outdoor walks, shopping, nightlife) | Helps prioritize activities |
| **Budget** (accommodation, dining, tickets) | Keeps the plan realistic |
| **Accommodation type** (hotel, Airbnb, hostels, boutique stays) | Influences location and transport |
| **Transportation** (public transit only, car rental, walking) | Affects daily logistics |
| **Any must‑see spots or “first‑time” experiences** | Ensures we don’t miss your top picks |
| **Dining preferences** (budget, cuisine, dietary restrictions) | Makes meal planning smoother |

If you’re happy with a general, balanced plan, let me know and I’ll draft a sample itinerary that covers iconic sights, a few hidden gems, and a mix of daytime and nighttime activities. Feel free to add any extra details or constraints!
